title: Color / Primary brand colors and Safety Blue
slide_intent: Distinguish the everyday palette from a meaningful accent so color can mark moments of support instead of becoming undifferentiated decoration.
strategic_value: The source links black and white to accessibility, simplicity and consistency; reserving Safety Blue can make Uber’s care moments more recognizable.
demonstration: Two explanatory sections sit beside tall white and black swatches and a blue strip spanning beneath them; each swatch carries production values.
practical_value: Use black and white as the primary palette and decide whether a user interaction warrants the sparing blue accent.

content_islands.name: Primary palette rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the primary-color explanation in the upper left opposite white and black fields with their values.

content_islands.name: Safety Blue role
content_islands.spec: Place the support, assurance and delight explanation in the lower left; place the labeled blue field beneath the two primary swatches.

ingredient.name: Primary palette and Safety Blue
ingredient.role: Provide a consistent neutral base and signal support at selected interactions.
ingredient.application: Use white and black as primary colors; use Safety Blue sparingly for support, assurance and delight.
ingredient.scope: October 2018 partner/sponsor communications; the field areas on this page do not establish numeric usage percentages.

reference_purposes.Intent: The page explicitly connects black and white with accessibility, simplicity and consistency, and blue with support, assurance and delight.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large white and black fields contrast with the blue band.
reference_purposes.Application: The page supplies RGB, CMYK, hex and PMS specifications for the three colors.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Safety Blue should be used sparingly at moments of interaction between user and brand.
